summary:
**MUSTACHE CASHTACHE– Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer**

MUSTACHE CASHTACHE is an educational 3D simulation game developed in Roblox that allows players to experience life and work on a lunar base. Designed primarily for young learners, the game transforms space exploration into an interactive learning experience where players take on the role of astronauts and complete missions on the Moon.

Through exploration, problem-solving, and mission-based challenges, players learn about lunar environments, astronaut responsibilities, space technology, and the difficulties of establishing a sustainable human presence beyond Earth. The project addresses the challenge of making space science more accessible and engaging by turning complex scientific concepts into hands-on gameplay rather than relying solely on traditional learning materials.

MUSTACHE CASHTACHE is important because it encourages curiosity about space, develops critical thinking and problem-solving skills, and inspires the next generation to explore science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). Our goal is to make learning about space exploration an exciting experience that anyone can enjoy.
details:
Project Details – Mustache Castache

Mustache Castache is an educational 3D lunar exploration and astronaut training game developed in Roblox Studio. The project aims to introduce players to the challenges of space exploration through an interactive and immersive Moon environment. Players can explore a lunar landscape, discover different elements of a simulated lunar base, and experience aspects of what it might be like to live and work on the Moon.

The game combines entertainment with education, making complex topics related to space science and lunar exploration easier to understand. Rather than learning exclusively through textbooks or videos, players engage with a virtual environment that encourages exploration, curiosity, and problem-solving.

Our intended impact is to make space education more accessible and exciting, particularly for younger audiences, while inspiring interest in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM).

We used Roblox Studio as our primary development platform, including its 3D building tools, terrain editor, environmental design features, and Lua scripting for game development. Our team worked using Windows computers.

The creative aspect of Mustache Castache lies in transforming the concept of astronaut training into an accessible gaming experience. We considered educational value, player engagement, visual atmosphere, usability, technical feasibility, and the scientific inspiration behind lunar environments. Our goal was to create more than just a game: an interactive starting point for the next generation of space explorers.
